# TimePicker

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTimePicker` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTimePicker.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTimePicker.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTimePicker.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Time, clock face

## Overview

A container, not a bare element: the editable field is a real UltraCanvasTextInput child (caret, selection, clipboard, undo, IME) rather than a private buffer painted by hand. The popup's spinners were always real elements; the field is one now too.

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasTimePicker](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTimePicker.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimePicker> CreateTimePicker( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h = 26);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimePicker> CreateTimePicker24h( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h = 26, bool showSeconds = false);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimePicker> CreateTimePicker12h( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h = 26, bool showSeconds = false);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimePicker> CreateClockTimePicker( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h = 26, bool use24h = true, bool showSeconds = false);   // Picker whose popup is the circular clock-face dial.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTimePicker(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasTimePicker(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasTimePicker(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onTimeChanged` | `std::function<void(const UCTime&)> onTimeChanged` | _Time changed_ |
| `onPopupOpened` | `std::function<void()> onPopupOpened` | _Popup opened_ |
| `onPopupClosed` | `std::function<void()> onPopupClosed` | _Popup closed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `UCTime`

hour is 0-23, minute/second are 0-59. A default-constructed UCTime (present == false) is treated as "empty/unset".

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `hour` | `int hour = 0` |  |
| `minute` | `int minute = 0` |  |
| `second` | `int second = 0` |  |
| `present` | `bool present = false` | false = empty/unset |

Methods: `IsEmpty`, `IsValid`, `ToSecondOfDay`, `FromSecondOfDay`, `AddSeconds`, `AddMinutes`, `Hour12`, `IsPM`, `Now`, `Format`, `Parse`

### enum `TimePickerPopupStyle`

Which kind of panel the field pops up.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Spinners` | hour / minute (/ second) spinners + AM/PM list |
| `Clock` | circular clock-face dial (UltraCanvasTimeClockView) |
